newsitem.title: USA: Coinmach Laundry buys related businesses.
newsitem.headline: Coinmach Laundry buys related businesses.

text.p: Coinmach Laundry Corp said it signed an aggreement to acquire the stock of Reliable Holding Corp for a cash purchase price of $44 million.
Coinmach also said it completed the acquisition of the assets of Atlanta Washer & Dryer Leasing Inc for a purchase price of $6.3 million in cash and promissory notes aggregating $1.2 million.

Reliable, headquartered in Glendale, Calif., provides coin operated laundry equipment services in California. It currently operates a base of approximately 49,000 machines in approximately 8,500 locations clustered around Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego and Tijuana, Mexico.
For the twelve months ended Jan. 31, 1996, Reliable had revenues of approximately $32.7 million and EBITDA of approximately $8.5 million.
The transaction will be financed with cash and borrowings under Coinmach's credit facility and is expected to be completed in early April, subject to certain approvals.

Atlanta Washer & Dryer, which does business under the name Appliance Warehouse, leases laundry equipment and other household appliances to property owners or managers, corporate relocation companies and individuals.
Appliance Warehouse is based in Atlanta, Georgia and also has operations in North Carolina and South Carolina.

The combination of Reliable, Appliance Warehouse and Coinmach for the twelve months ended Dec. 31, 1996, which include gains related to Coinmach's recent acquisition of Kwik-Wash, produced combined revenues of approximately $290 million and EBITDA of $90 million.
Coinmach provides coin-operated laundry equipment services for multi-family properties.
